results.title: Wildlife on the Edge 2: Bears
results.overview: Narrated by actor Tim Daly, the show looks at the dilemma of Black Bears living so close Los Angeles. Film features homeowners Brian and Rick who are dealing with Bears swimming in their pool; and features state Fish and Wildlife Officers.

results.title: Backwood Madness
results.overview: The war amongst men had an influence on the beings of the forest. Now the beings demand revenge. Balance between men and the forest has been broken.

results.title: Siren
results.overview: Doom-scrolling on a Friday night, Rett is drawn by an enchanting blue light to his backyard pool, where his digital obsessions lead to a fatal encounter.

results.title: Hot Girl Summer
results.overview: Three childhood best friends make a pact to experience their first orgasm before the end of summer vacation. One friend experiences a series of unexpected medical and anatomical mishaps that constantly disrupt her plans. Another tries to find sexual satisfaction within her heterosexual relationship, but gets entangled in a fierce rivalry with a female classmate that unexpectedly shifts into a romantic affair. The third focuses her efforts on pursuing and winning over her school crush, a transgender classmate. As their individual quests progress, a series of secrets, miscommunications, and chaotic events threaten to tear their tight-knit group apart before they finally find resolution and mutual support.

results.title: What Happened to Bobi
results.overview: A short documentary covering three reenactments of an alien abduction.

results.title: LOCKDOWN

results.title: Her Life Is on the Line
results.original_title: Her Life Is on the Line
results.overview: Hard-nosed talk radio personality Sarah Williams receives an on-air call from a man claiming that a murder will occur by the end of her late-night shift. It’s up to Sarah to figure out who this is and why he’s doing it… before it’s too late.

results.title: Where the Black Sand Burns
results.overview: Mateo lives in a small village near the crater of a volcano. As the volcano awakens, Alejandra, his love, sees it as an opportunity to leave and explore the world outside, while Mateo wishes to stay. As everything threatens to fall apart, Mateo realizes he has nowhere left to hide, not even behind the volcano.

results.title: Sweet Spot
results.overview: “Sweet Spot” is an experimental animated short film that uninhibitedly explores the dialog between the work and its authors, Jorge Ribeiro and Paulo Patrício, whose points of view and creative approaches, both in terms of cinematographic language and ways of being, are quite different. Through this duality, and starting from a shared but at the same time individual process, the directors seek to understand at what point the short film they are making together reaches its “sweet spot”. In other words, the ideal point at which the work is considered finished.

results.title: The Wood Thrush and Bobwhite Quail

results.overview: Biirdwatchers in Washington D.C. and Tennessee are summoned by Glenn Goins and George Clinton.

results.title: Steps (To Spread My Wings)

results.overview: In a society where everyone moves copy-paste, a couple “breaks” the matrix. They remember, fall in love, escape.

results.title: This Is NOT My Cow
results.overview: In a village often disturbed by military drills, the army sends soon-to-retire soldiers to take care of cows and sheep, hoping to build good relations with the locals. But this kind act cannot hide the long-term impact the drills have had on people’s lives.

results.title: Signals of Life
results.overview: In Lignan, a village of few souls in the Saint-Barthelemy Valley in the Aosta Valley, an Astronomical Observatory scans the skies every night.  Like a bell tower or a lighthouse, the large telescope marks the time of the small mountain community.  In autumn, the astrophysicist Paolo Calcidese moved into the structure as the sole custodian and inhabitant to carry out his scientific research and experiment with new technologies. Due to a technical accident, however, he will be forced to put aside the stars and solitude to dedicate himself to other forms of life not yet considered: human beings.

results.title: In the Name of the Empress
results.overview: While searching for the fountain of youth, the three best friends Romy, Karlheinz and Magda Gustav encounter a witch. She announces that the reincarnation of Empress Elisabeth is among them. They urgently need to find out who, otherwise the ghost will strike them down. A Sisi competition ensues - after all, who wouldn't want to be Empress and the once most beautiful woman in the world?

results.title: XVI. Tower
results.overview: Trapped in the confines of his hotel room a manager discovers a giant tower looming in the distant skyline, causing him to spiral into a state of confusion and forcing him to confront the fragility of his own sanity and the very nature of his existence.

results.title: Anywhere
